newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran and Chad sign agreement to boost cooperation.
newsitem.headline: Iran and Chad sign agreement to boost cooperation.

text.p: Iran and Chad signed a memorandum of understanding on Tuesday to boost cooperation between the two countries, state-run Tehran radio said.
It said Iranian First Vice-President Hassan Habibi and visiting Chadian Prime Minister Djimasta Koibla signed the agreement to increase diplomatic ties.
Under the agreement, Iran will provide technical training to Chad.
Koibla said Iran would help Chad in water and agricultural projects and in fighting the encroachment of deserts, the radio added.
Iran has been seeking to develop its ties with African and other developing countries which it sees as a potential market for Iranian goods and services.
